verify_detail: the counter only resets on `pm clear` (data wipe), not on a normal cold start. So any test suite that force-stops and relaunches the app repeatedly — without clearing app data between runs — will hit the hidden-button case on whichever runs land on counter values ≡ 2 or 4 (mod 5), independent of device, network, or load. Fix/mitigation: either clear app data before each test run, or have the test assert against the counter-derived expected state instead of assuming the button is always present.'
